name: plane-project-mcp
stderr:
plane-project-mcp: PLANE_API_KEY is not set. plane-project-mcp requires a Plane API token.
Get one from your Plane instance under Workspace Settings -> API Tokens, then set it as an environment variable, e.g.:

  export PLANE_API_KEY=plane_api_xxxxxxxx

or add it to the `env` block of your MCP client config.
